instruction: Vertical duplex conversion from init.ifc. Open C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init.ifc in Archicad and use C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init_plan.png and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init_section.png as references while converting it into the required two-storey vertical duplex. Replace any proxy or placeholder shell geometry with real BIM walls, slabs, roofs, storeys, and zones where needed. Save an IFC4 export to C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc. Keep the shaped model envelope approximately within min 0.0, 0.0, 0.0 and max 8.0, 6.0, 6.6, with 0.5 m tolerance. The IFC must have unique GlobalId values, exactly two building storeys, exactly two IfcSpace zones, at least eight walls, at least two slabs, and at least two roof elements. Create one zone named UNIT-A on one storey and one zone named UNIT-B on the other storey. Equivalent Archicad or IFC export internals, object names, relationship structure, materials, and property sets may vary; the required result is the stated BIM model and deliverables, not a byte-for-byte copy of the teacher IFC. [Software] Launch ArchiCAD with `C:\Program Files\Graphisoft\Archicad 27\Archicad` (adjust version/path).
